acceptanceCriteria: src/server.ts exports a named `app` (Express instance) separately from `listen()`; `listen()` is guarded by main-module detection (matching the tsup output format) so importing `app` in tests never binds a port
GET /health returns HTTP 200 with JSON { status: 'ok', uptime: <positive number> } regardless of whether RAPIDAPI_KEY is set or absent

GET / returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/html; response body equals the runtime file contents of src/public/index.html (read via fs.readFileSync or equivalent), never a hardcoded inline string; this route is never gated by RAPIDAPI_KEY

GET /cheapest with valid params returns HTTP 200 with the single cheapest FlightResult (price ≤ all others from same query); empty SkyscannerClient result → 404 { error: string }; missing required param → 400 { error: string }; adults defaults to 1 if absent

3. FlightResult interface is exported with exactly: price: number, currency: string, airline: string, departure: string, arrival: string, duration: number, stops: number

6. When the API returns a 4xx or 5xx status, searchFlights rejects with an Error that includes the HTTP status code
7. When the API response body is malformed or missing expected fields, searchFlights rejects with a descriptive parse/validation Error

9. tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no type errors
10. vitest run exits 0 with all tests passing
11. The apiKey is stored as a private field (private or # prefix) on the SkyscannerClient instance and is not publicly readable
12. When apiKey is passed as an empty string ('') to the constructor, SkyscannerClient throws the same missing-key Error as when apiKey is omitted entirely
13. When RAPIDAPI_KEY is set to an empty string in the environment and no apiKey is provided to the constructor, SkyscannerClient throws the missing-key Error
14. When an apiKey is provided to the constructor and RAPIDAPI_KEY is also set in the environment, the constructor-provided apiKey takes precedence

16. acceptanceCriteria: 1. `src/cli.ts` exists and `tsc --noEmit` reports zero errors
2. `tsconfig.json` sets `outDir` to `dist` and emits a module format compatible with `node dist/cli.js` invocation (CommonJS or ESM with .mjs extension consistently applied)
3. Flags `--from`, `--to`, and `--date` are all required; if any is absent the CLI prints a usage hint to stderr (showing correct flag names) and exits with code 2

4. The `--date` flag value must match the pattern `YYYY-MM-DD`; a value that does not match this format causes exit code 2 with a human-readable message written to stderr before any network call is made
5. Optional `--adults` flag defaults to 1 when omitted; a non-integer value, a value ≤ 0, or a non-numeric string causes exit code 2 with a human-readable message to stderr
6. The parsed `adults` value is forwarded as an argument to `SkyscannerClient.searchFlights` — the flag is not silently dropped
7. If `RAPIDAPI_KEY` env var is unset or empty, CLI prints 'Error: RAPIDAPI_KEY environment variable is required' to stderr and exits 1 before making any network call

8. When `searchFlights` resolves with one or more results, stdout contains: (a) a header row with columns Airline, Price, Departure, Arrival, Duration, Stops; (b) a separator row of hyphen characters whose width matches each column exactly; (c) one data row per result; all columns padded to the width of the widest value in that column (including the header label)
9. All columns except Price are left-aligned within their padded width; the Price column is right-aligned within its padded width
10. Price column values are prefixed with the currency symbol from the API response; if the API response omits a currency symbol, £ is used as the fallback
11. When `searchFlights` resolves with an empty array, stdout contains exactly the line `No flights found.` and process exits 0
12. When `searchFlights` rejects, the error message is written to stderr and process exits 1; stdout is empty

13. `src/cli.test.ts` contains at least 8 passing vitest tests covering: missing --from, missing --to, missing --date, invalid --adults value, missing RAPIDAPI_KEY env var, table rendered correctly for valid multi-row results (verify separator row present and column alignment), empty-array result renders 'No flights found.', and error path (client throws)
14. `vitest run` exits 0 with all tests green
15. No runtime dependency other than Node built-ins and packages already in `package.json` (from SKY-001/SKY-002) is added

The `listen()` call in src/server.ts is guarded by `import { pathToFileURL } from 'url'` and the condition `if (import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href)` (ESM output) or `if (require.main === module)` (CJS output) — the guard form must match the tsup output format so that `vitest run` never binds a port
GET /health returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/json and body matching { status: 'ok', uptime: <positive number> }
GET /health returns HTTP 200 regardless of whether RAPIDAPI_KEY env var is set or absent — the health endpoint is never gated by API key presence

GET /search with valid query params (from, to, date, adults) returns HTTP 200 with body { flights: FlightResult[], count: number, searchedAt: ISO-8601 string } where count strictly equals flights.length
GET /search missing any required param (from, to, or date) returns HTTP 400 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }
When the `adults` query param is absent on GET /search, the request succeeds (HTTP 200) with a default value of 1 passed to SkyscannerClient — `adults` is optional, not required
When the `adults` query param is present but non-numeric (e.g. 'abc', ''), GET /search returns HTTP 400 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }

GET /cheapest with valid required query params (from, to, date) returns HTTP 200 with a single FlightResult whose `price` field is less than or equal to the `price` field of every FlightResult returned by SkyscannerClient for the same route/date (validated against a mocked client response); if `adults` is supplied it is forwarded, if absent it defaults to 1
GET /cheapest returns HTTP 404 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string } when SkyscannerClient returns an empty array for the given route/date
GET /cheapest missing any required param (from, to, or date) returns HTTP 400 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string }

When RAPIDAPI_KEY env var is absent at server initialisation, a single middleware (or equivalent) short-circuits GET /search and GET /cheapest with HTTP 503 Content-Type application/json body { error: 'RAPIDAPI_KEY not configured' }; GET /health and GET / are unaffected and return their normal responses

When SkyscannerClient throws an error during a /search or /cheapest request (e.g. network failure, upstream 5xx), the server returns HTTP 500 with Content-Type application/json and body { error: string } and does not crash or emit an unhandled promise rejection

The `searchedAt` field in the GET /search response is an ISO-8601 datetime string reflecting the time of the request (not a hardcoded value); successive requests separated by at least 1 ms return distinct values

The FlightResult type used in src/server.ts is imported from the SKY-002 type export (e.g. src/skyscanner/client.ts) and not redeclared inline — type definitions must not diverge between the client and server layers
package.json contains a 'start' script with value 'node dist/server.js'
package.json contains a 'build' script (tsup or equivalent) that produces dist/server.js such that `npm run build && npm run start` successfully starts the server and GET /health returns HTTP 200

package.json 'build' script copies src/public/ (or equivalent) into dist/public/ as part of the build — after `npm run build`, dist/public/index.html exists and `npm run build && npm run start` serves the real dashboard file (not a 404 or a stale/hardcoded fallback) from GET /
supertest and @types/supertest are listed in package.json devDependencies

src/server.test.ts contains at least 8 vitest tests, each covering a distinct scenario from the criteria above, with SkyscannerClient mocked (vi.mock or equivalent) so no real HTTP calls are made during `vitest run`
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no type errors
vitest run exits 0 with all tests passing

Server reads PORT from env (default 3000); reads RAPIDAPI_KEY from env and passes to SkyscannerClient. If RAPIDAPI_KEY is absent at startup all API routes (/search, /cheapest) return 503 { error: 'RAPIDAPI_KEY not configured' }; /health and / are never gated. The listen() call must be guarded so importing `app` in tests does not bind a port. Add 'start' script in package.json pointing to 'node dist/server.js'. The build script must copy src/public/ into dist/public/ as part of `npm run build`, since tsc alone does not copy non-.ts files — the file path used by the / route handler must resolve correctly both under `tsx src/server.ts` (dev) and `node dist/server.js` (built). acceptanceCriteria: 1. `src/cli.ts` exists and `tsc --noEmit` reports zero errors
2. `tsconfig.json` sets `outDir` to `dist` and emits a module format compatible with `node dist/cli.js` invocation (CommonJS or ESM with .mjs extension consistently applied)
3. Flags `--from`, `--to`, and `--date` are all required; if any is absent the CLI prints a usage hint to stderr (showing correct flag names) and exits with code 2

4. The `--date` flag value must match the pattern `YYYY-MM-DD`; a value that does not match this format causes exit code 2 with a human-readable message written to stderr before any network call is made
5. Optional `--adults` flag defaults to 1 when omitted; a non-integer value, a value ≤ 0, or a non-numeric string causes exit code 2 with a human-readable message to stderr
6. The parsed `adults` value is forwarded as an argument to `SkyscannerClient.searchFlights` — the flag is not silently dropped
7. If `RAPIDAPI_KEY` env var is unset or empty, CLI prints 'Error: RAPIDAPI_KEY environment variable is required' to stderr and exits 1 before making any network call

8. When `searchFlights` resolves with one or more results, stdout contains: (a) a header row with columns Airline, Price, Departure, Arrival, Duration, Stops; (b) a separator row of hyphen characters whose width matches each column exactly; (c) one data row per result; all columns padded to the width of the widest value in that column (including the header label)
9. All columns except Price are left-aligned within their padded width; the Price column is right-aligned within its padded width
10. Price column values are prefixed with the currency symbol from the API response; if the API response omits a currency symbol, £ is used as the fallback
11. When `searchFlights` resolves with an empty array, stdout contains exactly the line `No flights found.` and process exits 0
12. When `searchFlights` rejects, the error message is written to stderr and process exits 1; stdout is empty

13. `src/cli.test.ts` contains at least 8 passing vitest tests covering: missing --from, missing --to, missing --date, invalid --adults value, missing RAPIDAPI_KEY env var, table rendered correctly for valid multi-row results (verify separator row present and column alignment), empty-array result renders 'No flights found.', and error path (client throws)
